verdict.rationale: EBANX is an API-first payments platform, so it can be driven headlessly. It documents a direct server-to-server API with JWS request signing, a single unified API, a sandbox environment with test cards and expected responses, and signed HTTP notifications with retries. Nothing addresses CI pipelines, a CLI, or non-interactive tooling specifically. missing for 10: official CLI or headless tooling, CI/CD integration guidance, a published OpenAPI spec (probe found none), independent corroboration of automated usage.
